text: Revise docs/design/records-history.md and accept D112 in docs/decisions.md, with these three changes decided under Sri's delegation (BRIEF.md addenda of 2026-10-23): (1) the records history is a branch named athena/records with its own root, not the custom ref refs/athena/records, so the host's branch rules can forbid force-pushes and deletion and a plain clone carries it; update every place the design names the ref, and the A4 row of the options table. (2) Add a section on readers: every part of Athena that reads records today from records/ in the working tree (status, forecasting and the reference forecaster, scoring, retry carry, audit, introspection, the study site generator) and how each reads from the records branch after the cutover (for example a worktree of athena/records kept at a fixed path), with the job in the build plan that moves them. (3) State that the pre-merge status depends on the host requiring branches to be up to date before merging, so a squash's parent equals the head's base. Fill the open points: pending window 15 minutes; cutover after build job 6; two weeks between job 7 and job 8. D112's status becomes accepted, citing those addenda. Only docs/design/records-history.md, docs/decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md change.
